values.review_scope: Exact internal kernel listener and Guardian client, config/TLS identity, live continuity operations, persistence/replay/streams/cleanup, public-surface denial, focused tests/proof/evidence, typed issue truth, and absence of distributed policy or cloud scope.
review_prompts: Can any non-Guardian identity or public route reach continuity dispatch, or can the internal listener bind beyond loopback?
Do quiesce/export and stage/validate use the live kernel continuity coordinator and exact bounded signed bytes rather than synthetic proof?
Do client and server replay, deadlines, cancellation, crash, restart, reply loss, and rotation reconcile without duplicate effects or false results?
Can any caller choose a path, escape the fixed roots, race an opened handle, overrun bounds, or leave unverifiable residue?
Are bundle and possession handles opaque and evidence fully redacted?
Does the exact proof bind all thirty-six cases without claiming #204 policy or final operational/cloud integration?
